name: WhatsApp Call
description: Compact WhatsApp call activity: tilted green phone symbol on the left, live green/orange waveform on the right, and microphone, End call and camera controls.

settings.title: Refresh
settings.description: Active-call fallback interval. Idle checks slow to 3 seconds; closed apps to 15 seconds.

settings.title: WhatsApp Desktop App
settings.description: Detect calls opened in the WhatsApp macOS app.

settings.title: WhatsApp Web In Tabs
settings.description: Detect calls in web.whatsapp.com browser tabs via Apple Events.

settings.title: Fallback Without JavaScript
settings.description: Show the activity from the in-call URL when JavaScript from Apple Events is unavailable, with unknown mic and camera state.

settings.title: Diagnostic Activity
settings.description: Show a fake call so you can preview the interface without joining one.

settings.title: Live Waveform
settings.description: Live levels on the right of the compact activity, from your already-authorized microphone. No new microphone permission prompt.

settings.title: Other Participant Audio
settings.description: Capture the call app audio as well. Optional: macOS may request system audio recording permission.
